description: Search videos on YouTube, TikTok, or Instagram with optional YouTube filters (upload_date, duration, sort, captions). Searching costs 0 credits. Optionally set transcripts=true to expand up to 10 videos inline (billed at normal transcript credits per delivered video).

captions.description: When true, restrict YouTube results to videos with captions.

chunks.description: Split transcript into o200k_base token chunks (true for defaults, or { max_tokens, overlap_tokens }).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous search response.

engine.description: Transcript engine for inline expansion; defaults to captions.

max_transcripts.description: Maximum videos to expand when transcripts=true (default 5, max 10).

query.description: Search query string (required unless paginating with cursor).

transcripts.description: When true, expand transcripts inline for returned videos (billed normally).

name: transcriptlab_search_videos
title: Search videos
